_about: Words Edge TTS (bn-BD-NabanitaNeural) says wrongly, and the spelling Edge is given instead. Only the text sent to Edge changes; the cards, questions and site keep the normal spelling. Whole words only: কোন changes, কোনটা and কোনো do not (add them as their own entries if Edge gets them wrong). 'say' is what Edge gets. 'try' lists spellings to compare with: python3 scripts/edge_backup.py --test-respell. After changing 'say', re-record with --redo-respell (never touches Gemini recordings).
